verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains general descriptions of Svelte as a compiler-based UI framework and community sentiment, but no documentation or hands-on evidence discussing embedding Svelte components into an existing page, compiling to custom elements, or other incremental-adoption mechanisms. Missing for 10: docs on custom element compilation, examples of dropping Svelte into a non-Svelte page, migration guides showing partial adoption, and independent confirmation of such usage.
